Please respond on S-thread six zero niner.|A [[Unidentified communications officer (Gabrielle)|communications officer]]|<ref name="Star By Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>}}
[[File:S-ThreadMatrix-CRFG.png|thumb|right|250px|A diagram of an S-thread matrix.]]
'''S-threads''', popularly known as '''Simu-Tunnels''', were [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] matrices that connected [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|non-mass transceivers]] in a vast coordinated matrix that formed the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].<ref name="IS">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

S-threads were extremely small [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] tunnels used to ferry communications waves through. Due to their incredibly small dimensions, it was virtually impossible to intercept communications through an S-thread; the only way to do so was to attach a listening device to the [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transceivers]] responsible for managing information through the S-threads.

A public [[PanComm S-thread booth]] was installed at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Corocus]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]].<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

==History==
The S-threads were used to run the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. They were also used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]], and the [[Imperial Hyperspace Security Net]] used them to detect incoming vessels.

[[S-thread booster/Legends|S-thread boosters]] were a technology used to open up [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] where [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] conditions meant that none could naturally exist. Such boosters were used to create the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]], the [[Byss Run/Legends|Byss Run]] and the [[Sanctuary Pipeline/Legends|Sanctuary Pipeline]]. However, they were considered an extremely expensive and inefficient technology.
